title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=x^2$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{4-2}{8}=0.25$$. The midpoints of the subintervals are $$2.125$$, $$2.375$$, $$2.625$$, $$2.875$$, $$3.125$$, $$3.375$$, $$3.625$$ and $$3.875$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$M_8=0.25\left(f{\left(2.125\right)}+f{\left(2.375\right)}+f{\left(2.625\right)}+f{\left(2.875\right)}+f{\left(3.125\right)}+f{\left(3.375\right)}+f{\left(3.625\right)}+f{\left(3.875\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$18.656$$.
